codeReview.summary: The feature added several explicit return annotations in the targeted files, but it did not fully satisfy the stated scope because multiple targeted agent-loop/service functions still lacked explicit return types after the commit.

issues.description: `assemblePreparedAgentLoop` still contains three targeted object-literal methods without explicit return annotations (`switchActiveModel`, `persistRecoveredModelSelection`, and `captureErrorClassificationContext`). The feature description and expected behavior required the agent-loop/service functions in this scope to receive explicit return types.

The streaming callback passed to `streamText` (`onChunk`) still has no explicit return type in this feature commit, leaving another targeted agent-loop helper unannotated despite the explicit-return-type sweep requirement.
`emitHistoryPrepared` remains without an explicit `: void` return type in this commit even though `prepare.ts` is part of the targeted agent-loop scope described for the feature.
